name: Localization (i18n) + Urdu RTL Support
description: End-to-end localization strategy for UI and notifications across Studio, Admin, Client Portal, Invitations, and Public Profile. India-first language set with Urdu RTL. Includes locale resolution rules, translation lifecycle, and RTL-safe component guidelines.
goals: Consistent locale resolution across all surfaces (authenticated and share-link based).
Translation keys and content localization that remain stable across releases.
Localized formatting for dates, numbers, currency (INR), and address conventions.
nonGoals: Real-time machine translation for arbitrary user-generated content (UGC) (optional enhancement).
Automatic translation of uploaded media text (handled by AI features if needed).

rules: Workspace may set default_language; users may set preferred_language.
Share links may override language (link-local) for client portal/invitations.
Localization configuration is workspace-scoped; translation catalogs are global per app version (unless enterprise overrides are enabled).

actors.name: Workspace Admin
actors.description: Sets workspace default language and client portal language defaults.

actors.name: Client (Share Link)
actors.description: Sees client portal in link/gallery language.

workflows.name: Locale Resolution Order
steps: Share-link surfaces (portal/invitations/public pages): share_link.language -> gallery.portal_language/invitation.language -> workspace.default_language -> Accept-Language -> en-IN.
Persist last choice per surface to reduce user friction.
Apply RTL direction for ur-IN consistently (html dir=rtl, logical CSS properties).

workflows.name: Translation Catalog Lifecycle
steps: All strings referenced via stable keys (no raw UI text in code).
Catalogs versioned with application release; missing keys fall back to en-IN and log telemetry.
RTL review checklist for layouts, icons, paddings, truncation, and number formatting.
Automated i18n tests validate no missing keys for supported locales.

controls: Do not accept arbitrary locale strings without validation (allowlist locales).
Do not allow translation catalogs to contain executable content (no HTML injection; use safe rendering).
Ensure localization does not leak sensitive information through fallback strings.

alerts: Spike in missing translation keys after deploy

acceptanceTests: Client portal renders RTL correctly for ur-IN (layout mirroring, punctuation, numerals).
Locale resolution matches documented order for both user and share-link surfaces.
Missing translation keys fall back to en-IN and emit telemetry.
